data.raw_text:
week recap (one of the craziest weeks I’ve had) 🤣

> went to Dubai to prepare for the @ShardDubai annual event.
> then got stranded because of the Iran-Israel-US tension.
UAE was technically safe, but flights started getting messy.
> needed to go home for health reasons → panic buying tickets while prices were insane.
> UAE → Oman (9 hour trip).
> from Oman my route was supposed to be:
India → Thailand → Philippines.
> plot twist: Philippines passport needs a visa for India.
found out at the airport. 🥲
> had a small breakdown, called family, booked a new route:
Oman → Thailand.
> landed in Thailand… but my baggage stayed in Oman. fml. 🙃
> meanwhile the market was nuking and I’m questioning my career.
> finally landed in the Philippines.
got held at customs.
> went for a check-up and almost got admitted.

week full of uncertainties but somehow dodged everything. 😎

market was down that week…
but so was I lol. 🤣
